prompt: A wide-angle view from a doorbell mounted beside a front door, looking out at the doorway of a terraced house: the door stands open onto a dim hallway with a bicycle leaning against a radiator. Jenny stands in the doorway on the left of the frame with her arms folded and her brows pulled together, her mouth flat, eyes fixed on Brandon. Brandon stands on the right of the frame on the doorstep, his shoulders open, brows slightly raised, already half turning his body away towards the street. The lens bulges slightly at the edges, daylight from the street is blown out to white behind the doorframe, and the colour is flat and compressed with fine video noise. A chipped boot scraper and a wilted plant in a margarine tub sit by the step. Thanks.
